evidence.suspension_mechanism: Automated Trust & Safety systems + human review for account/bot termination
evidence.appeal_process: Support ticket via Discord Support (https://dis.gd/contact); no public SLA for response time
evidence.transparency_reports: Semiannual Transparency Reports covering: account actioned, content actioned, government requests, intellectual property
evidence.government_requests: Government and law enforcement requests for user data tracked in reports
evidence.no_independent_oversight: No external oversight board (unlike Meta Oversight Board)

impact.description: Account/bot suspensions via automated + human review. Appeal only through support ticket with no public SLA. Transparency reports provide aggregate numbers but zero individual visibility. No independent oversight body (Meta has Oversight Board, Discord does not). Cloudflare bans for 'Invalid Requests' add another opaque ban layer.

remediation.notes: Appeal via support ticket only; no public metrics on appeal success rates
